title: Add concrete MCP tool names to each activate_* tool description
description: R2 from codebase audit tool-discovery audit. The activate_* tool descriptions describe categories abstractly without listing the concrete tool names that will appear. Append to each: "Activates: memorysmith_task_create, memorysmith_task_get, memorysmith_task_list, ..." This lets agents pattern-match instantly instead of guessing what the category contains. This is a VS Code extension / MCP host code change outside this repo.
